dedupe_keys.name: fields of the world field boundary processing tools

description: The Fields of the World baseline repository hosts the project's Python command-line tools for deriving agricultural field boundaries from satellite imagery. It includes data preparation, model training, evaluation and inference, with steps for Sentinel-2 retrieval, segmentation, land-cover filtering and polygonisation. Inputs are imagery, model configuration and selected weights; outputs include boundary predictions and field polygons. Coverage follows the supplied scenes and the model's training domain. Public software is free under MIT, while the README distinguishes attribution-only model weights from a full model with noncommercial restrictions. A limitation is that weight selection changes permitted use and inference behaviour; the maintainers also plan to move the CLI to another repository. The tools can prepare field geometry for irrigation and food-supply simulations, complementing the existing CY-Bench yield benchmark (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). Existing catalogue entries describe the Fields of the World dataset and derived maps, not this separate processing package. No imagery, weights or field-boundary files were downloaded.
name: Fields of the World field-boundary processing tools
